international_aviation.headline: 利雅德機場重開 抵離航班須事先獲準
international_aviation.summary: 利雅德的 King Khalid International Airport 於10月18日重開，並在關閉超過一週後恢復營運。重開不代表營運限制全面解除：NOTAM A3650/26規定，所有抵達及離場航空器均須事先取得沙烏地阿拉伯民航總局許可；NOTAM A3651/26則列明，機場不可作為預定備降機場。
international_aviation.headline_en: Riyadh Airport Reopens With Prior Permission Required for All Flights
international_aviation.summary_en: King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh reopened on 18 October and resumed operations after more than a week of closure. Restrictions remain in place: NOTAM A3650/26 requires prior permission from Saudi Arabia’s General Authority of Civil Aviation for all arriving and departing aircraft. Under NOTAM A3651/26, the airport is unavailable for use as a planned diversion airport.
